Name: Digimon Ranch for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Digimon, digital monsters, Digimon are the CHAMPIONS!

I'm back with yet another request! This time I have taken DonValleyParkway's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7396]Digimon Ranch[/url], whose assets were open for use, and rewrote the whole mod to work with SDV 1.6, ADDING the mons as new livestock rather than overwriting vanilla animals! There are a lot of mons in this one, so buckle up:

[b][u]Coop-Mons:﻿
[/u]
[/b]-Pabumon: produces slime every day
-Koromon: Produces eggs every day
-Tentomon: produces fiber every day
-Piyomon: produces piyo feathers every other day
-Agumon: produces fire quartz every other day
-Gummymon: produces slime every day
-Terriermon: produces rabbit's feet every 5 days
-Tsumemon: produces a strange bun every 5 days
-Keramon: produces void essences every 5 days
-DemiVeemon: digs up geodes
-Veemon: produces solar essences every 5 days
-Guilmon: produces dinosaur eggs every 5 days

[b][u]Barn-Mons:

[/u][/b]-Bukamon: produces soapstones every 5 days
-Tapirmon: produces solar essences every 5 days
-Bullmon: produces milk every day
-Gomamon: produces anchovies every 3 days
-Ikkakumon: digs up frozen geodes
-Salamon: digs up quartz
-Oryxmon: produces goat milk every day
-Xiaomon: digs up dandelions
-Pillomon: produces wool every other day
-Sheepmon: can be sheared for wool every 3 days
-Armadillomon: digs up geodes
-Ankylomon: produces dinosaur eggs every 5 days

Enjoy!
